description: JavaScript functions for handling address copying, UI toggling, setting return values, adding related contacts, map location search, and contact address setting in the vtiger CRM Contacts module.

methods.name: copyAddressRight
methods.description: Copies mailing address fields to the corresponding 'other' address fields in a form.

methods.name: copyAddressLeft
methods.description: Copies 'other' address fields back to mailing address fields in a form.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Toggles the display style of an HTML element between 'none' and 'inline'.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets parent name and ID in the opener window's form based on a product selection.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist_incal
methods.description: Adds a contact ID and name to the related contacts list in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets contact name and ID in the opener window's form for detail view.

methods.name: set_return_toDospecific
methods.description: Sets contact name and ID in the opener window's form for Todo items.

methods.name: submitform
methods.description: Submits a mass delete form with a specified entity ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation
methods.description: Opens Google Maps with a query based on selected address fields.

methods.name: set_return_contact_address
methods.description: Populates contact address fields in the opener window's form, with confirmation for overwriting existing data.
